# Vue.js QA Task

Validate the requested Vue.js change using `agents/vue-qa.agent.md` and the Vue Playwright skill.

Inspect `package.json`, scripts, lockfile, configuration, and dependencies. Reuse Vitest, Jest, or another compatible runner; use Vitest with Vue Test Utils when none exists. Use Playwright for browser journeys. Map every acceptance criterion to a test case and evidence. Cover success, validation boundaries, loading, empty, error, unauthorized, pending, security, and regression states.

Run focused tests, lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, production build, and browser tests in order. Test supported Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and applicable mobile projects at desktop, tablet, and narrow-mobile viewports. Apply WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 with WCAG 2.2 Level AA as the primary target. Report commands, results, coverage, artifacts, skipped coverage, and residual risk.
